أنطرق (form VII)

# أَنْطَرِقَ (ʔanṭariqa) /ʔan.tˤa.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# أَنْطَرِقْ (ʔanṭariq) /ʔan.tˤa.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
